findings.summary: The function name pattern accepts a leading underscore, so a config line can schedule a module's private helpers.
A module is allowed when its name merely starts with an allowed name, so allowing "tasks" also allows "tasks_admin" or "tasksx".
Any callable attribute of an allowed module is accepted, including functions it imported (shutil.rmtree, os.system), not only functions defined there.
Each job is added to the scheduler as soon as its line is read, so when a later line is invalid the jobs before it stay scheduled.
A zero interval is accepted, and schedule's Job._schedule_next_run then adds a zero period forever, so one config line such as 'every 0 seconds do ...' hangs load_jobs and the application.
